trust_decision.summary: Which X509 trust store wolfSSL uses to verify the server: once set up (including by an application's CURLOPT_SSL_CTX_FUNCTION callback), Curl_wssl_setup_x509_store must not run again; at the pinned commit the 'done' flag is only set on the populate path, so a CA-cache hit leaves it unset and a later handshake-time call swaps the callback's store for the cached one.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'CA-cache hit overrides callback'; the cache-hit branch of Curl_wssl_setup_x509_store is where wolfSSL_CTX_set_cert_store installs the cached store.

fix_sites.entry_point: curl_easy_perform/curl_multi_perform with wolfSSL backend and CURLOPT_SSL_CTX_FUNCTION (TLS over TCP, HTTPS proxy, HTTP/3)
fix_sites.module_kind: TLS backend internal helper (wssl_populate_x509_store), flag removed

fix_sites.entry_point: same; Curl_wssl_setup_x509_store is the shared function called from TCP connect, BIO read and QUIC before_recv
fix_sites.module_kind: TLS backend exported helper (Curl_wssl_setup_x509_store), flag added at function top

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver fixing at the callers (e.g. setting the flag after the callback-block call at lib/vtls/wolfssl.c:1423-1427) could dismiss the HTTP/3 caller lib/vquic/vquic-tls.c:134-138 as 'QUIC, a separate transport'; but the published one-function fix covers it automatically, and the flag lives on wctx so the caller-level fix also covers it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: CA-file store must still be loaded before the application callback runs (callbacks expect a populated store; NO_FILESYSTEM builds rely on the callback), and CA-cache sharing across transfers must keep working when no callback is set; an over-broad fix that skips setup or disables the cache whenever a callback is set changes those.

O6_input_shapes: cache hit, cached store already in CTX (lib/vtls/wolfssl.c:815-818)
cache hit, different store in CTX e.g. replaced by callback (lib/vtls/wolfssl.c:819-821)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: OpenSSL QUIC before_recv path not setting octx->x509_store_setup after Curl_ssl_setup_x509_store, so a later call re-installs the cached store over a callback's store
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The wolfSSL branch right below (lib/vquic/vquic-tls.c:134-138) does not set the flag at the caller; a maintainer harmonising the two could drop the line.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Flag set only inside a populate path in Curl_ssl_setup_x509_store instead of at callers, mirroring the wolfSSL bug
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: wolfSSL and OpenSSL setup functions are near copies (lib/vtls/openssl.c:3300-3339 vs lib/vtls/wolfssl.c:793-844).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: GnuTLS cache-hit branch relying on cached creds' trust_setup; a variant where shared_creds are not swapped would leave trust_setup unset
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Cache-hit branch sets no flag itself while the populate branch does (lib/vtls/gtls.c:686), same shape as the bug.

O9_family: CWE-295 improper certificate validation: application-configured trust store silently replaced by cached default store (stale state/idempotence flag)

O10_build.toolchain: autotools or CMake, gcc/clang; curl must be built against wolfSSL (non-default backend), HTTP/3 needs ngtcp2/nghttp3 or quiche
services: local TLS test server (runtests stunnel or tests/http pytest httpd/nghttpx)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/libtest/lib758.c uses CURLOPT_SSL_CTX_FUNCTION; no wolfSSL CA-cache + callback test found; fix diff adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set wctx->x509_store_setup = TRUE in the cache-hit branch only, or after the callback-block call at lib/vtls/wolfssl.c:1424; both work, so there is little room for a wrong fix.

out_of_scope_notes: On a cache hit the callback receives a CTX whose store is the shared cached store (lib/vtls/wolfssl.c:819-821, 1428), so callback edits could mutate the shared cache; same in OpenSSL (lib/vtls/openssl.c:3323-3324); not pursued.
Schannel has its own CA cache (lib/vtls/schannel.c:2750-2758) but no SSL_CTX callback; not pursued.
unverified: single_site red flag withheld only because the diff edits two functions (flag moved from wssl_populate_x509_store to Curl_wssl_setup_x509_store); in practice it is a single logical one-line move at one place, and no O2 site or O8 route exists.
O1=2 counts TLS-over-TCP/HTTPS-proxy and HTTP/3 (lib/vquic/vquic-tls.c:134) as distinct entry points; both go through the one fixed function.
Whether lib758 runs under a wolfSSL build was not checked.
Advisory text itself was not available; the trust decision is inferred from the summary and the diff.
